title: Horizontal Sanitary Tee Mistake
description: Using a standard sanitary tee on a horizontal-to-horizontal waste line transition is a common mistake that leads to frequent drain clogs. Sanitary tees are designed primarily for vertical-to-horizontal transitions where gravity helps direct flow. On horizontal runs, the sweep of a sanitary tee is too short, causing solids to accumulate and slow down flow velocity. To maintain self-scouring velocity and prevent blockages, plumbing codes require a wye with a 1/8 bend or a combination wye and 1/8 bend for horizontal changes of direction. Always verify local plumbing codes for approved fitting sweeps.
